identity: An Islamic-education (تربية إسلامية) multiple-choice exam question bank, school level, scraped without punctuation or option lettering. Twenty items, one per <NL>-delimited block. Each item is STEM + 3 to 5 OPTIONS. Content mixes fiqh (oath, jihad, ablution), akhlaq (haya, forbidden acts), sira (Hijra, Zubayda), tajweed (madd badal), and Muslim scientists (Ibn al-Nafis, Ibn Firnas, al-Idrisi). Recurring option 'جميع ما ذكر' (= all of the above) closes eight of the twenty items and is the single clearest proof of the MCQ format. This is doctrine genre I — my worst genre in batch 1 (33.3 F1) — so the format law, not prose intuition, governs everything below.
law: The sentence unit here is the EXAM CONSTITUENT: one stem, then one unit per option. Three laws do all the work. (1) I2 — THE STEM ENDS WHERE THE OPTIONS BEGIN, even mid-phrase. This document strands the colon on a copula or a function word eight times: هو @86 @168 @300 @502, هي @224 @538, عندما @362, بينها @403, and on a bare heading NP @445 or an instruction verb وضحها @329. (2) I3/I4 — EVERY option is its own unit however short (أولئك, حنة, واجب, شرط, سنة, ركن are all one-token units); the detection signal is N consecutive constituents of the same syntactic type with ZERO connective between them, and the short-tail rule 0b is SUSPENDED. (3) THE DOCUMENT'S OWN DISCRIMINATOR, which I derived from this text and which resolves every hard site: OPTIONS ARE SEPARATED ASYNDETICALLY; و MARKS CONTINUATION *INSIDE* AN OPTION. Not one option in all twenty items opens with a connective. Therefore every internal و rides, and every zero-connective seam cuts. This is the local form of the conjunct-weight test (doctrine §0) with the sibling boundary as the arbiter, and it overrides the bare A1/B1 default of cutting at و and ف, which applies only inside the running-prose stems.
reasoning: SITE 1, block 2 @48-63 (الخوارزمي وابن الهيثم / ابن سينا والرازي / ابن خلدون وابن رشد / ابن النفيس والزهراوي / جميع ما ذكر). Eight scholar names — four options of two, or eight options of one? The و alternates with perfect regularity: it sits on exactly every SECOND name and never on the first. Eight independent options would carry و on none or all. So these are pairs, و is intra-option, and the seams are the four asyndetic ones. Note this is risk-free either way: 50/53/57/60 are boundaries under BOTH readings; only 48/51/54/58 differ, and I decline them. Confidence hi on what I list. SITE 2, block 6 @139 ولعن المتشبهات. Conjunct-weight (§0) screams CUT — لعن is a finite verb with its own object. I decline. The three real options open with BARE لعن (@123, @131, @134); this one opens with ولعن. Under the document's discriminator that و is intra-option, and semantically the two halves are one hadith about التشبه, one ruling, one answer choice. Cutting would also force me to shred option 1 at ويأثم-type seams everywhere else. SITE 3, block 11 @208-247, the hardest block. The preamble runs four clauses: تكتسب الأخلاق... الالتزام / فلها أحكام شرعية / فمن هذه الأخلاق ما هو حرام / والحرام هي. B1 says clause-initial ف = CUT; 0b says a 3-word dependent tail is absorbed. فلها أحكام شرعية is 3 words and is a pure entailment of the clause before it — exactly the @701 shape where gold absorbed the short ف-clause and cut at the NEXT connective. So I absorb it and cut at @216 before فمن. I then absorb والحرام هي (2 words) into the فمن clause, so the stem ends on the stranded copula هي @224 — one colon, not two. The options are three, not four: ما يثاب فاعلها ويأثم تاركها (= wajib) / ما يثاب فاعلها ولا يأثم تاركها (= mandub) / ما يأثم فاعلها ويعزز ويؤدب على ارتكابها ويثاب من تركها طاعة لله (= haram, the correct answer). I refuse the tempting cut at @242 before ويثاب: that tail is the second half of the standard fiqh definition of haram, it opens with و while all three real options open with bare ما, and ويثاب من تركها طاعة لله cannot stand alone as an answer choice. Repeated opening ما is the sibling marker here, exactly as لعن was in block 6 and إذا is in block 12 and الحياء is in block 19. SITE 4, block 13 @300-307. أحد الأمور الآتية... الكريم هو | أن له بكل حرف خمس عشرة حسنة | عشر حسنات | حنة | خمس حسنات. Two readings: either the stem ends at the copula هو @300 and option 1 carries the full frame أن له بكل حرف, or the stem runs on and strands بكل حرف @304 as the colon (the H1 dangling-stem shape). I take the first. هو is already a complete colon and two colons in a row is not a pattern this document shows anywhere; and in scraped banks the frame conventionally appears on the first option with the rest elliptical — here it sits on a DISTRACTOR (fifteen hasanat), not on the correct answer (ten), which is what you expect from a typographic convention rather than a shared stem. Marked med. @307 is a boundary under both readings, so hi. I also decline a cut at @285 between the doubled قال: L1 breaks an isnad at each NEW transmission verb, but this is one attribution accidentally doubled, and E3 keeps a quote glued to its قال — one hadith citation, one chunk. SITE 5, block 14 @314-329. Stem is four clauses: استفاد... بالتفكر / فأبدعوا... العلمي / فكانت لهم بصمات / وضحها. Budget 0c allows one to two; the third connective is the boundary. So unit A = clauses 1+2, unit B = clauses 3+4, cut at @325, and I do NOT cut at @320 (5-word ف-tail, absorbed by 0b). I do NOT cut at @328 before وضحها: J6 precedent (توجيهات لإنقاذ الأرض أحددها) makes noun-phrase + instruction verb one unit, and وضحها is what turns the lead-in into a question. Both @216 and @325 are med — they are the only two places I cut inside a stem, and a defensible gold could keep each stem whole. I take them because my batch-1 error profile is 7:1 in the merge direction, so the cut is the positive-expected-value call. SITE 6, block 16 @418 والتزام and @430 واحترام. G2 says coordinated verbal nouns with their own complements each get a unit, and both conjuncts are heavy (7 and 5 tokens). I decline both, because the three real options open with bare verbal nouns (اختيار @404, اختيار @411, عقد @426) and none opens with و — the same discriminator as sites 2 and 3. Each option here is a two-action method, precisely as each option in block 2 was a two-name pair. Same verdict for وبرزوا فيه @338, وتخلصوا @375, والفهم الخاطئ للإسلام @452, ومكانة العلماء @473. SITE 7, block 17 @468 و يرفع, where the و is its own token. It coordinates with يدعو INSIDE the relative clause headed by الذي; الذي is a tight subordinator that never opens a unit. No cut. SITE 8, the one-token option runs. @72-75 (أولئك ءاتينا أيه أبناء), @87-90 (اسرافيل مالك ميكائيل جبريل), @503-506 (الحياء الأمانة التواضع الصدق), @539-542 (واجب شرط سنة ركن), and the stray typo حنة @310. Batch 1 cost me ~20 consecutive misses on exactly this shape (J1 word drills) and 33.3 F1 on exactly this genre. I3 is absolute: one word, one unit. CROSS-CHECK: blocks 5 and 7 pose different questions with an identical option set (عباس بن فرناس / الادريسي / جميع ما ذكر), and my segmentation returns identical units for both — independent confirmation that عباس بن فرناس is one option and that the 3-option count is real.
